product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring to help enterprises develop workforce capabilities at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage directly describes an enterprise learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring: https://disprz.ai/

pricing_page.notes: Disprz has a publicly accessible plans-and-pricing page: https://disprz.ai/pricing

employee_band.notes: Disprz's LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/13366982

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official address places the North America headquarters in West Orange, New Jersey, and LinkedIn identifies West Orange as headquarters: https://disprz.ai/company/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/13366982 | hq_country: The company lists its North America headquarters in West Orange, USA, and its LinkedIn company profile identifies West Orange as headquarters: https://disprz.ai/company/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/13366982

founded_year.notes: Disprz's funding announcement explicitly states that it was established in 2015: https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/disprz-ignites-the-future-of-workplace-learning-and-skills-with-us30m-series-c-funding-301894503.html

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains LMS comparisons, training guides, and L&D marketing topics. Its engineering-teams article concerns training software, not how Disprz is built; the index did not establish two qualifying engineer-authored technical posts: https://disprz.ai/blog

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes a substantive external API guide, a separate Hibob integration guide, and a LinkedIn Learning integration guide covering SSO, catalog synchronization, and reporting: https://disprz.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PS/pages/2760245302/Disprz+External+API+guide ; https://disprz.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PS/pages/2768011273 ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/learning/lms-integrations/integration-docs/disprz

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official live posting is for an AI Content Operations Intern and offers an application option. It qualifies under the specified AI-in-title rule; this is a GenAI content-operations role, not an engineering or research vacancy. The separately found AI Engineer ads were closed: https://disprz.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/140799

model_provider.notes: Microsoft's Disprz case study explicitly identifies Azure OpenAI as powering personalization and learning-material accessibility: https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/aifirstmovers/disprz

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Disprz's trust center claims ISO 27001:2022 certification, SOC 2 Type II attestation, and GDPR compliance. raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified financing is the August 2023 Series C, before the eighteen-month window beginning in May 2025: https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/disprz/01gasqtv7pilzz9c4 and https://www.prnewswire.com/apac/news-releases/disprz-ignites-the-future-of-workplace-learning-and-skills-with-us30m-series-c-funding-301894503.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page lists no qualifying SDR, BDR, or Account Executive title; its AD Sales and Presales roles do not qualify. Detailed Account Executive and BDR postings explicitly say applications are closed, outweighing an aggregator's active label: https://disprz.keka.com/careers ; https://jobs.highfivepartners.com/companies/disprz/jobs/70488465-account-executive ; https://lumoscapitalgroup.getro.com/companies/disprz/jobs/86968087-business-development-representative-sharjah-ajman

launched_6mo.notes: Disprz announced its Autonomous Enablement OS on September 28, 2026, within the six-month window. This is a substantive AI-native product launch: https://disprz.ai/blog/disprz-launches-autonomous-enablement-os and https://www.ptinews.com/press-release/disprz-crosses-130-crore-arr-and-launches-autonomous-enablement-os-pioneering-a-new-category-beyond-traditional-l-d/4107975

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ranganathan Vasan's profile dates his Disprz Vice President and Head of Finance role to April 2026, within the twelve-month window; Disprz's team page confirms the executive title. This supports a recent VP-role start, without relying on conflicting departure information: https://linkedin.com/in/ranganathan-vasan and https://disprz.ai/company/about-us
